parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to return per page.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token for the next page of results. Omit this for the first request. For subsequent requests, set this to the `NextToken` from the previous response.

parameters.name: Q
parameters.description: The search keyword for a fuzzy match on Skill names.

parameters.name: Visibility
parameters.description: Filters the results by visibility level. You can specify multiple values.
